newsitem.title: PERU: Peru's Fujimori to meet Clinton Monday.
newsitem.headline: Peru's Fujimori to meet Clinton Monday.

text.p: Peru's President Alberto Fujimori will meet U.S. President Bill Clinton in Washington on Monday to thank him for his backing during the Lima hostage crisis, government officials said.
Fujimori will leave Lima late on Thursday for Toronto, where he has a meeting scheduled with Japanese Prime Minister Ryutaro Hashimoto on Saturday morning, they added.
He then travels to Washington on Sunday.

The Peruvian president has received a string of statements of support from the Clinton administration since Tupac Amaru Revolutionary Movement (MRTA) rebels stormed the Japanese ambassador's residence in Lima on Dec. 17 where they still hold 72 VIP hostages.

The meeting with Hashimoto is intended to plan strategy for breaking the stalemate in the 44-day crisis, which has stalled over the government's refusal to consider the rebels' main demand for the release of about 400 prisoners.
Two dozen of the hostages are Japanese.
